prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's downward trend pattern, while FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.5307). However, catboost dominates overall RMSE (33.18) despite moderate trend/seasonality correlations. The series shows high unpredictability (spectral entropy 0.99) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.15), making robust combiners like median/trimmed_mean essential to avoid overfitting noise.
